# Hover card

A preview card that appears on hover or focus.

<p class="odv-compstatus"><span class="odv-pill odv-pill-out">Left out of Accessible first</span> Touch screens have no hover, and public services are used on any device. A person with a tremor completes a form on a tablet. <span class="odv-instead">Use instead: <a href="./collapsible">Collapsible</a></span></p>

## When to use it

- **Use it when:** A quick look at a person or link for people with a mouse, with the same detail reachable on click.
- **Not when:** The only way to see the content: touch screens have no hover.

Instead:

- [Popover](./popover.md): Opens on click, works on touch.
- [Tooltip](./tooltip.md): A one-line hint.

## Words

- Use common words. Explain any term you must use.
- One idea per sentence. Put the action first.
- Never blame the person.
- Use: Continue, Change, Start, You. Avoid: Invalid, Utilise, Submit, Error code.

The labels components use, from the voice tokens:

- `content.action.commit`: Continue
- `content.action.cancel`: Go back
- `content.action.destroy`: Delete
- `content.action.retry`: Try again
- `content.action.empty-action`: Start a new application

See [Voice and tone](../voice.md) for the whole voice.

## Use it in code

```bash
npx open-ds add hover-card
```

The component reads only component keys and semantic tokens, so it follows the brand and mode on `<html>`.
